title: Quantifying the Quarantine
tagline: Simulating a zombie outbreak across the Czech Republic.
summary: A zombie outbreak spreading across Czechia, simulated on a 1 km population map. Every square kilometre runs Munz et al.'s humans–zombies–removed model, with zombies wandering, humans fleeing and the dead rising, as a front of bites sweeps out from Prague, Brno or Ostrava. Draw blockades and seal regions to contain it, built by a single crew at a fixed pace.
